questions.prompt: What is the main benefit of a multi-stage Dockerfile?
options: Smaller runtime image without build tools or dev dependencies
questions.explanation: Build in one stage, copy only the artifacts into a slim runtime stage.

questions.prompt: Next.js server code in the web container calls fetch('http://localhost:4000'). It fails in Docker. Why?
options: localhost in a container is that container itself; use the service name http://api:4000
questions.explanation: Each container has its own network namespace; services reach each other by Compose service name.

questions.prompt: Changing NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL in the container's environment at runtime changes what the browser bundle uses without rebuilding.
questions.explanation: NEXT_PUBLIC_* values are inlined into the JS at build time.

questions.prompt: Which are part of the Day 2 server lock-down?
questions.explanation: Keys only, no root login, default-deny firewall with only required ports.

questions.prompt: You publish Postgres with ports: ['5432:5432'] while ufw denies 5432. What happens?
options: Likely reachable from the internet, because Docker modifies iptables directly
questions.explanation: Docker-published ports bypass ufw rules. Bind to 127.0.0.1 or don't publish.

questions.prompt: Which record points app.example.com to an IPv4 address?
questions.explanation: A records map names to IPv4 addresses.

questions.prompt: app.example.com (Next.js) and api.example.com must share the login cookie. Which attribute is needed?
questions.explanation: Domain=.example.com makes the cookie available to subdomains; Secure + SameSite=Lax in production.

questions.prompt: In a deploy, when should migrations run?
options: Before switching to the new version, aborting the deploy if they fail
questions.explanation: A failed migration should stop the deploy and leave the old version running.

questions.prompt: Why tag images with the git SHA?
options: Traceability and easy rollback to an exact previous build
questions.explanation: Every deploy is identifiable and reversible.

questions.prompt: Your nightly backup job runs fine for months. What proves you can recover?
options: A restore drill into a fresh database with data checks
questions.explanation: Only a tested restore proves recoverability.

questions.prompt: It's fine to keep production secrets in the repo if the repo is private.
questions.explanation: Keep secrets on the server/secret manager; repos leak and history persists.

questions.prompt: The API container restarts in a loop right after deploy. First step?
options: docker logs <container> (look for a missing env var or crash message)
questions.explanation: Logs show the crash reason; missing environment variables are a classic cause.
